references.text: Saul was commanded to destroy all the Amalekites, but he spared King Agag, showing the same pattern of incomplete obedience that Moses criticizes here.
Midianite women led the Israelites into idolatry at Baal-Peor, which is the background for Moses' anger that the women were spared.
The direct continuation where Moses commands which women should be killed and which should be spared.
The law regarding how Israel was to treat hostile nations in the promised land, forbidding anyone to be left alive.
Joshua completed the ban on Jericho by killing all its inhabitants, showing complete obedience in contrast to the commanders in Numbers 31.
